newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner sees gold price at $300-340 to end-1997.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner sees gold price at $300-340 to end-1997.

text.p: Gold bullion should trade in a $300-340 per ounce range for the rest of 1997, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said in a weekly market report on Friday.
Gold was now better supported after it plummeted to 12-year lows last week, but upside moves would be limited because of potential mine sales, it said.
Upside resistance was pegged at $326, which the price could rise to $331, but the bank believed this was not very likely.
